# FAQ Frequently Asked Questions & Subscribe and Renew FAQ How to subscribe and renew package plans on the iTick platform. The complete process of selecting a package, confirming orders, and completing payments, along with renewal operation guidelines to help users easily manage service subscriptions.

## How to Subscribe to a Plan

### Step 1: Choose a Plan

Log in to the [iTick official website](https://itick.org/en) where you can switch between different plan types and select the one that best suits your needs (not all stock markets are listed; you can view all available stock markets by clicking "Purchase" to enter the order page). If none of the plans meet your requirements, please contact our 24-hour customer support.

![iTick Select Plan](/images/faq/en-us/select-plan.webp)

### Step 2: Confirm Your Plan

1. Confirm the plan type (e.g., Comprehensive Market, Stock Market, Futures Market, Fund Market) and its contents.
2. Confirm the payment plan and price. For any pricing questions, feel free to contact our 24-hour customer support.
3. Confirm the currency for payment.
4. Confirm the payment network.

![iTick Confirm Plan](/images/faq/en-us/order.webp)

### Step 3: Make Payment Immediately

Click the "Pay Now" button to generate a pending order. Follow the instructions to complete the payment and gain access to the service. If you have any questions, please contact our 24-hour customer support.

## How to Renew Your Subscription

### Step 1: Select the Plan to Renew

Log in to the [iTick Dashboard](https://itick.org/dashboard), choose the subscription you want to renew, and click the "Renew" button.

![iTick Renew Plan](/images/faq/en-us/renewal.webp)

### Step 2: Confirm Renewal Details

1. Confirm the renewal plan and API KEY.
2. Confirm the payment plan and price. For any pricing questions, feel free to contact our 24-hour customer support.
3. Confirm the currency for payment.
4. Confirm the payment network.

![iTick Renewal Order](/images/faq/en-us/renewal-order.webp)

### Step 3: Make Payment Immediately

Click the "Pay Now" button to generate a pending order. Follow the instructions to complete the payment and renew your subscription. If you have any questions, please contact our 24-hour customer support.
